0022600019.text: The Orlando Magic (1-3, 11th in the East, 4th in the Southeast and 1.5 games back, on a one-game losing streak) visit the Toronto Raptors (3-1, 3rd in the East, 3rd in the Atlantic and 0.5 games back, on a one-game winning streak) in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group A game, the fifth of the season for Orlando. Orlando is missing Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain) and Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), while Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture). The Magic trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 129-99 in their last meeting in Toronto, and they lost 1-2 to the Raptors in 2025-26.
